eligibility.item_classes: all item classes supported by the engine

restored_properties: all explicit modifier identities, sides, rolls, and flags
all implicits and their rolls and flags
all enchantments and their rolls and flags
checkpoint_model.immutable_identity_behavior: The checkpoint is bound to the same live item. Creation and restoration preserve that item's identity, base identity, and item level.

create.checkpoint: create an exact snapshot of the entire mutable item state and bind it to the live item

restore.live_item: replace the entire mutable state of the same live item with the bound checkpoint snapshot
restore.identical_state: successful restoration; consume the checkpoint even though the live item state remains equal

create_refusals: an active checkpoint already exists for the item
refusal_failure_and_consumption.create_refusal_effect: leave the item and any existing checkpoint unchanged and consume no beasts
restore_refusals: checkpoint is bound to a different item
refusal_failure_and_consumption.restore_refusal_effect: leave the live item and checkpoint unchanged and consume no beasts or checkpoint
refusal_failure_and_consumption.restore_success_consumption: consume the checkpoint and no beasts
refusal_failure_and_consumption.no_op_outcome: none; creating a checkpoint changes checkpoint state, and restoring an identical state is still a successful checkpoint-consuming operation

representation_requirement: This recipe requires explicit live-item plus optional saved-checkpoint state. It must not be represented as an ordinary one-item action over the live item alone.
